languages.codeHint: Any BCP 47 tag, for example nl-NL or en-US. Public URLs use this code as the path prefix.
languages.deleteConfirm: Remove {code}? Pages and posts in this language are kept, but visitors will no longer see it in the language switcher.

menus.title: Menus
menus.subtitle: Build navigation menus from published content and custom links
menus.primaryHint: This menu appears in the site header.
menus.noPublished: No published items of this type yet.
menus.emptyHint: Add published content or custom links from the panel on the left.
menus.unsavedLeave: You have unpublished menu changes. Switch menus anyway?
menus.unpublishedNotice: Unpublished changes are saved as a draft and shown in the preview below.
menus.stylePresetHint: Renders the link with a style class. Built in: button, button-outline, button-ghost. Set a URL like /login and pick "button" to turn the item into a call-to-action.

button.title: Button style
button.hint: Overrides the theme's button colours for this one item. Leave a field blank to keep the theme default.

menus.relHint: noopener noreferrer is always added automatically.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.authHint: The public site has no separate visitor accounts — "signed-in" means an admin-panel session.
visibility.devicesHint: Presentation only — every device still receives the item; this just hides it visually.

dropdown.title: Submenu behavior
dropdown.disableParentLink: Trigger only (this item does not navigate)
dropdown.widthHint: Fit content sizes the panel to whatever's inside it — the usual cause of cramped, wrapping columns in a mega menu. Set a fixed width to give it room.
dropdown.offsetHint: Shifts the open panel from where it anchors under the item. Use a negative horizontal value when a panel runs past the right edge of the screen. Automatic edge-flipping and the mobile stacked layout still apply on top of this.

mega.title: Mega menu columns
mega.heading: Region heading
mega.contentHint: Build this column with text, images, buttons, link lists, and layout blocks — only block types safe for menu content are offered here.
mega.customHint: You're editing raw blocks — text, images, buttons, link lists, and layout blocks. Only block types safe for menu content are offered here.
mega.useAdvanced: Need something else? Switch to the advanced block editor

design.title: Layout & design
design.mobilePatternHint: How the menu opens below the breakpoint. Drawer and Fullscreen dim the page behind them and lock scrolling; Dropdown is a panel under the header; Accordion just expands the list in place.
design.mobileMotionHint: How the drawer / panel animates open and closed. Visitors who ask their system for reduced motion always get the instant version.

design.title: Design
design.subtitle: Choose a CSS framework — packages are installed locally when activated
design.deleteConfirm: Delete this CSS provider? This cannot be undone.
design.emptyHint: Upload a .jfpkg package or use a bundled provider below.

patterns.title: Pattern library
patterns.name: Pattern name
patterns.syncConfirm: Keep inserted copies synced when this pattern is updated?
patterns.choose: Choose a pattern to preview it at page width.

animation.title: Animation
animation.hint: Motion effects for this block. Visitors who prefer reduced motion see the final state immediately.

style.title: Custom CSS
style.hint: Styles this block only. Use & for the block itself; a selector without it matches inside the block.
style.classNameInvalid: Class names may only use letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores.
style.devicesHint: Presentation only — every device still receives this block; it is just hidden visually outside the selected sizes. Mobile ≤ 600px, tablet 601–1024px, desktop ≥ 1025px.
style.cssRejected: This CSS was rejected. @import, url(javascript:…) and similar constructs are not allowed.
style.tokensHint: Click a variable to add it as & { … } in the box above, then edit the value.

json.title: Block JSON
json.hint: Edit this block directly. The block keeps its id; everything else is replaced on apply.

pageJson.title: Page JSON
pageJson.hint: Nothing is selected, so this is the whole page. Select a block on the canvas to edit it on its own.
pageJson.stale: The page changed on the canvas. Discard to load it, or apply to overwrite it.

placement.title: Position on the grid
placement.hint: This block sits in a {columns}-column grid. Drag it on the canvas, or set exact numbers here.

layout.title: Spacing & size
layout.hint: Steps on the theme's spacing scale, so the page keeps its rhythm and tightens up on small screens.
layout.inheritedHint: Inherited theme values are shown after Auto and in the colour swatches. They remain inherited until you change them.

reusable.title: Reusable block
reusable.hint: Save this block to reuse it on other pages. Linking keeps them in sync — edit the saved copy and every page follows.
reusable.name: Name
reusable.referenceHint: This is a reference. Edits to the saved block appear on every page using it.
reusable.missing: That saved block no longer exists.

themeControls.title: Theme styling
themeControls.hint: This block's take on the theme's look — overrides the site-wide setting.

permalinks.title: Permalinks
permalinks.description: Choose public URL structures for your content and taxonomy archives.
permalinks.failed: Could not load or save permalink settings.
permalinks.saved: Permalinks saved. {count} previous content URLs recorded for 301 redirects.
permalinks.warning: Changing URLs can affect search rankings and external links. Known published URLs are redirected automatically. Imported URLs, ambiguous URLs shared by multiple items, deleted content, handwritten links, and unrecorded historical URLs cannot be mapped automatically. Review redirects after saving.
permalinks.name: Post name
permalinks.tokens: Tokens: %year%, %monthnum%, %day% (UTC publication date), %postname% (slug), %id% (content UUID), %category% (first category slug), %author% (author ID), %type% (content type). Include %postname% or %id%.
permalinks.baseHelp: Use a path such as resources/articles, without surrounding slashes. Leave a type base empty to keep its slug at the site root.
permalinks.localeHelp: Locale prefixes appear before the structure. The default locale has no prefix; other enabled locales keep their full locale tag. The homepage stays at the locale root.
